Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly reasoned that "salt water" is the universal necessity for all animals at the beach, rather than "producers." While salt water is essential for many marine organisms, it is not universally required by all animals (e.g., some birds and mammals at the beach do not directly rely on salt water). The Planner also dismissed "producers" by incorrectly stating that not all animals eat producers directly, neglecting the fundamental ecological principle that producers are the base of the food chain and indirectly support all animals in the ecosystem. This error occurred during the analysis phase when the Planner made the final decision without consulting any specialists.
